import sqlite3, json

    s_id, title, model, started_at, last_activity_at = row
    msgs = c.execute('SELECT role, content, timestamp FROM messages WHERE session_id=? ORDER BY timestamp ASC', (s_id,)).fetchall()
    sessions_data.append({
        'session_id': s_id,
        'title': title,
        'model': model,
        'started_at': started_at,
        'last_activity_at': last_activity_at,
        'messages': [{'role': m[0], 'content': m[1][:500] if m[1] else '', 'timestamp': m[2]} for m in msgs]

with open('.agents/sync/hermes_sessions_summary.json', 'w') as f:

print(f'Exported {len(sessions_data)} Hermes sessions to .agents/sync/hermes_sessions_summary.json')
""

        TARGET_TAG=$(git tag -l "*restore-point*" --sort=-creatordate | head -n 1 || true)
